verdict_reason: Tests now check inputs and outputs with no spies, but they re-declare species rows that the shared test support already exports, and they reuse the production linesOf name for a different helper.

todos.issue: The test re-declares species rows the feature's shared test support already exports: DOMESTIC_CAT, CATTLE_OR_COW and the tuples ['0102','Bos taurus','Cattle or Cow'], ['0102','Bison bison','Bisons Spp'], ['01061900','Felis catus','Domestic Cat'], ['01061900','Canis familiaris','Dog'] (lines 4-5, 23-25, 43, 60-62) are field-for-field the BOS_TAURUS_ROW, BISON_BISON_ROW, FELIS_CATUS_ROW and CANIS_FAMILIARIS_ROW exports of commodities/search/test-support.js.
todos.fix: Must: the species rows used here come from the shared commodities test support, with no local copy of their codes, Latin names or common names. One way: import the *_ROW constants from ../../search/test-support.js, build lines from them (index + entry: row), and assert names via row.commonName; add an ostrich row there if a non-individual second code is needed.

todos.issue: The test helper linesOf(...triples) (line 9) shares its name with the production linesOf(answers, evaluation) in ../lines.js, which the code under test sits beside, but takes different input (code/Latin/common tuples) and builds index+entry pairs directly. One name, two concepts in one feature folder; a reader of this test predicts the engine collection view.
